difficulty_evidence.easy: Observed integral-point arithmetic templates. Five complete rated source banks. Two unrated originals remain excluded.
difficulty_evidence.moderate: Authored half leading coefficient with three integral coordinate substitutions. Same operation and response format.
difficulty_evidence.hard: Authored fractional leading coefficient, two nonintegral half coordinates at every queried point, quadratic/rational forms. Same three substitutions and response format.

default_bank: Explicit complete authored coordinate-substitution profile; seven observed profiles replay separately.
distinctness: Canonical expression and unordered exact point set; seeds, UUIDs, ordering and choice profiles cannot create extra inventory.
finite_limit: No shortage at target 5 in the tested bounded sampler; finite domain is explicit in validate_parameters, no infinite-capacity claim.
grading: Actual native grade_field accepts one and rejects four image choices per question.
